claimed_coverage: Tests that the policy overriding_defined_variables_isnt_restricted correctly reports violations based on the restrict_user_defined_variables field in GitLab repository data.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix.patch adds the policy rule overriding_defined_variables_isnt_restricted in policies/gitlab/repository.rego that returns false (violation) when input.restrict_user_defined_variables is true, exposing the restrict_user_defined_variables field from gitlabcollected.Repository to the Rego policy engine.
issue_context_used: The issue requires exposing restrict_user_defined_variables field from gitlabcollected.Repository to the Rego policy engine, and the policy should report violation when the field indicates user-defined variables can be overridden.
notes: The verifier applies test.patch at runtime to add the TestGitlabRepositoryRestrictsOverrideVariables test. The test verifies that the policy overriding_defined_variables_isnt_restricted exists and behaves correctly: when RestrictUserDefinedVariables=false, the policy reports a violation; when RestrictUserDefinedVariables=true, no violation is reported. The test fails on buggy code (policy missing) and passes on fixed code (policy present and working). The -v flag was added to go test to produce verbose output with individual test names and PASS/FAIL status, ensuring at least 2 non-blank lines in the test output body. A go build ./... step was added after patch application to ensure embedded policies (via //go:embed directives) are recompiled with the fix applied.
